Extract from S.B. Report dated 16.1.45. re Anarchist matters.

The following information (additional to that submitted by me on 5-1-45) has been obtained concerning Anarchist matters:-

5. Willi FREIMANN and Michael PETERSON, under whose names articles have appeared in "War Commentary", are aliases of John OLDAY, Also known as Frank ALLEN.
